finding: All seven handoffs lack a matched native launch receipt. The first four had concurrent user desktop operations; attempts five through seven had an exclusive desktop and still launched the installed application. Attempt six used SHCNF_FLUSH plus F5; attempt seven leased a unique owned default ProgID while leaving the original command untouched. Both failed, and all temporary values were restored. A cached handler remains a hypothesis, not a proven cause.

accidentalLaunch.limitation: Existing runtime started with a test file and may have performed ordinary startup/draft writes. No manual project/account edits were made. Do not claim user runtime was never used.

review.rejectedHypothesis: Absence of notification: original lease already called SHChangeNotify on arm/restore.

historicalLeaseFailure.fix: Detached hidden watchdog with independent stdio; four safety paths subsequently passed.
